profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary: I’ve graduated from UC Irvine as a Computer Science major. I’m currently a senior software engineer at Intuit since 2021.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Interned on the iOS Quickbooks team
•	Pushed two features on the Quickbooks Accounting IOS app into production
•	Using modern language Swift 5.1, built UI 100% programmatically, wrote unit tests and queried data using GraphQL
•	Worked in an intern pod that was 100% remote
•	Met regularly with PM/XD team to gather requirements

positions.title: IOS Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Converted legacy Objective-C code to Swift 5
• Released my solo project a profile page for the Omada Health IOS App onto the App Store
• Used pair-programming and test-driven development methodologies to build two new features
• Gained experience writing unit tests, acceptance tests, using Jenkins for continuous integration, and querying data with GraphQL

positions.title: IOS App Developer Course
positions.description: A semester long project-based course app development focusing on the design and implementation of RESTful API clients. Built 3 fully functional app assignment projects and 1 original app.

positions.title: SMASH Rising/Ideo Fellow
positions.description:
SMASH Rising is a career readiness program for SMASH alumni entering their first or second year of college. In partnership with SMASH's industry allies, who range from large tech leaders to research centers, SMASH Rising gives alumni access to cutting-edge companies where they gain real-world experience, learn problem-solving skills and build their network.

Alumni teams participating in SMASH Rising use design and prototype thinking to solve relevant challenges facing these organizations and put the skills they’ve honed at the Academy into action. The program takes place during the summer and each pod will have a Project Manager who will lead and support alumni throughout the 4-week experience.

At IDEO CoLab, my pod and I used design and prototype thinking skills to explore making blockchain feel simple and human-accessible. Our briefs revolved around making public keys humanly readable and creating a system for storing private keys that is simple, yet secure.

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor
positions.description: Teaching an online Computer Science and Game Development with Python course to 14 high school juniors from underrepresented backgrounds.

positions.title: SMASH Scholar
positions.description: SMASH Academy provides a tuition-free, intensive STEM education to high school students of color focused on college and career readiness. The three year SMASH Academy program, a 5-week residential experience for each of the three summers during high school focused on developing the knowledge and skills that Scholars will need to help build strong, diverse and socially conscious teams.

positions.title: Project Designer
positions.description: Designed an interactive scholarship application that rewards students for completing academic and enrichment opportunities. The purpose of this application is to motivate students from Middle School and High School to seek a higher education.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description: Created IOS applications using Swift and Firebase. Programmed an application to track shooting accuracy in Soccer.

positions.title: Google & Hispanic Heritage Foundation: Digital Marketing Fellow
positions.description: For six weeks I learned digital marketing skills from Google's digital marketing team and applied them to Dr. Marc Santamaria's immigration law firm. We improved his website's user interface and loading speed, created a google business listing, performed one-on-one marketing, and launched advertisements in areas that were highly concentrated by our targeted audience.

positions.title: Soccer Referee
positions.description:
-Officiated 204 soccer games ranging from 7-18 year olds
-Typically worked in teams of 3 to 2 referees but it wasn't uncommon for me to officiate a game by myself

positions.title: Student Tutor
positions.description: I spent 3 to 6 hours during the weekdays tutoring struggling high school students in their math and science courses.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Associate's Degree in Math and Science

courses.name: Data Structure Implementation and Analysis in C++

honors.title: SpaceX Scholarship
honors.description: Received for hands-on engineering spirit and technical achievements

organizations.name: Hispanic Heritage Youth Award
organizations.description: Out of 20,000 students who applied to the Hispanic Heritage Youth Awards, I was one of the few that was selected as the recipient for a scholarship. Hispanic Heritage Youth Awards aims to support young Hispanic high school seniors who have proven their leadership capabilities and their passion for a specific category. I received the silver award in the Innovation and Technology category.
